description: Header file defining MIOpen descriptor classes and utility functions for tensor and convolution descriptors in the ATen library.

classes.name: Descriptor
classes.description: Template class for managing MIOpen descriptor objects with automatic resource management.

classes.name: TensorDescriptor
classes.description: Class for managing MIOpen tensor descriptors, including setting tensor shapes and formats.

classes.name: FilterDescriptor
classes.description: Class for managing MIOpen filter descriptors, including setting filter shapes.

classes.name: ConvolutionDescriptor
classes.description: Class for managing convolution descriptors, including setting convolution parameters.

classes.name: DropoutDescriptor
classes.description: Class for managing dropout descriptors, including setting dropout parameters.

classes.name: RNNDescriptor
classes.description: Class for managing RNN descriptors, including setting RNN parameters.

classes.name: Constant
classes.description: Union for representing constant values of different data types used in MIOpen operations.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Various overloads for setting tensor, filter, convolution, dropout, and RNN descriptors with specific parameters.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Method to print tensor descriptor details.
